## About Me
I'm a passionate software developer. I enjoy building efficient and scalable applications, whether it's frontend interfaces or backend logic.
I value to do things right, even if it means taking a little extra time doing just that. 

My interest in computers and software originated ~20 years ago, I started tinkering with high-level languages such as, Javascript, HTML, CSS. Back then, I primarily focused on web-development, yet gradually expanded my knowledge to PHP, databases, web servers, Linux, and virtualisation technologies.

For several years now, my interests have shifted towards low-level languages like C and C++, sparked by my interest in 3D graphics and the Vulkan API. Also gathered some experience with SoC's, Docker and Github CI/CD to automate releases/docs or recurring tasks for some of my projects.

I also strive to be helpful to fellow developers, whether that means sharing knowledge, explaining concepts, or assisting when asked.

**Experience with**: `PHP`, `JavaScript`, `HTML`, `CSS`, `Python`, `C`, `C++`, `Java`, `MySQL`

### VM Manager
[![repo](https://img.shields.io/badge/View%20Repository-grey.svg?logo=github)](https://github.com/mhoek2/vmmanager)
[![build](https://github.com/mhoek2/vmmanager/actions/workflows/binary.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/mhoek2/vmmanager/actions/workflows/binary.yml)

> The Official VMware Workstation lacks some accessibility support and is not fully screen-reader-friendly. \
\
This Python application provides an accessible, web-based interface for managing essential virtual machine functions, such as controlling power states and showing the assigned IP addresses. Focussing on accessibility using ARIA html attributes to help visually impaired users.
